name: TickSaver Mix
description: Input buffer mix: early-press buffer (ground + orbs), hold extension and minimum hold, with a small overlay. Not for leaderboard or list submissions.

press-window.name: Early press window (ticks)
press-window.description: A click that cannot be used yet (cube/ball/robot/spider in the air) is remembered for this many ticks and fired when you land or touch an orb. 0 = off. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS.

use-orbs.name: Buffer for orbs
use-orbs.description: Also fire the buffered click when you touch an orb or pad.

min-hold.name: Minimum hold after buffered click (ticks)
min-hold.description: If you already released before the buffered click fired, the release is delayed this many ticks so the jump registers.

hold-extend.name: Hold extension (ticks)
hold-extend.description: Delays every release by this many ticks. A new click in that window cancels the release. 0 = off. Can break orb timing.

overlay.name: Show overlay
overlay.description: Shows settings and number of saved clicks in the top-left corner.
